description: This file sets up event listeners for buttons in a renderer process of an Electron application, facilitating IPC communication with the main process for actions related to Linux password management and user guidance.

methods.name: DOMContentLoaded event listener
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for DOM elements when the document is loaded.

methods.name: click event handler for #use-storage-button
methods.description: Sends a message to the main process to use local storage for the keychain.

methods.name: click event handler for #quit-button
methods.description: Sends a message to the main process to quit the application.

methods.name: click event handler for #learn-more
methods.description: Sends a message to the main process to learn more about keychain access and reveals additional info in the UI.
